title: Spoilage Allowance Linked to the Appliance Failure Claim, Northgate Protect
content:
A spoilage allowance is added to a Northgate Protect Standard-tier food-loss payment according to the failure claims: the mechanical-failure and power-surge claims filed on the plan with the same incident date as the food-loss claim.

- **Where any of them was approved:** the greater of the covered-failure allowance of $25.00 and the disposal rate of 10 percent (0.10) applied to the food loss claimed.
- **Where none was approved and one was denied with the manufacturer-warranty denial:** the disposal rate of 10 percent applied to the food loss claimed.
- **Otherwise:** nothing.

The allowance is figured on the food loss claimed as recorded on the claim, before any limit or share.

## Decision table

| Same-day mechanical-failure or power-surge claim | Allowance added |
|---|---|
| At least one approved | The greater of $25.00 and 10 percent of the food loss claimed |
| None approved; one denied with the manufacturer-warranty denial | 10 percent of the food loss claimed |
| None filed, or none approved and none denied that way | Nothing |

## Cases on hypothetical figures

- Food loss claimed $180.00; the freezer's mechanical-failure claim of the same day was approved: 10 percent is $18.00, so the greater, $25.00, is added.
- Food loss claimed $320.00; same-day power-surge claim approved: $32.00 is added.
- Food loss claimed $180.00; the same-day mechanical-failure claim was referred to the manufacturer under its warranty: $18.00 is added.
- A mechanical-failure claim whose incident date is a day earlier than the food-loss claim's incident date is not a same-day failure claim, and nothing is added for it.
